'''Bondara's Folly''' was a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] that shared its name with [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Anoon Bondara]]. A unique [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]], it caused the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] blade to give off a light-brown [[Color/Legends|color]]. When tuned by a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], it became a focusing crystal and was only usable in that particular individual's lightsaber. Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] collected and combined various crystal fragments from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to produce Bondara's Folly.

==Properties==
Bondara's Folly was a [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystal]] that caused the blade of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to take on a light-brown hue. When properly tuned by a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] for use in a lightsaber, it became a focusing [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] and could only be used in lightsabers constructed by the individual who tuned it.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
Bondara's Folly was a unique lightsaber crystal and shared its name with [[Anoon Bondara]],<ref name="SWG" /> a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who was regarded as one of the finest fighters and [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] instructors in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|84&ndash;85|Bondara, Anoon}}</ref>

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars Galaxies}}
Sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] began collecting disparate crystal fragments from various [[Planet/Legends|planets]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]&mdash;some rare, some mundane&mdash;and combined them to form rarer crystal shards. Once having collected all the various shards, the spacer combined them to form Bondara's Folly.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Bondara's Folly appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> When used in the player's lightsaber, the crystal caused a portion of the inflicted damage to be of the acid type, and once tuned, the crystal could only be used by that player.<ref name="SWG" />

Bondara's Folly was part of a series of 19 unique lightsaber color crystals created in the context of the [[W:c:swg:Publish 9 Notes for 29 June 04|Publish 9]]'s Jedi system revamp<ref name="SWG:js">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other|jedi_spam.stf}}</ref> in [[June]] [[2004]].<ref name="P9">{{SonyCite|url=recent_updates.jsp?page=Recent%20Updates|text=Publish 9 Secrets of the Force}}</ref> However, only one of those crystals — [[Sunrider's Destiny]] — was made available in the game.<ref name="SWG:CEL">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=general|Capture Enemy Leadership|Dathomir}}</ref> Bondara's Folly and the other crystals were not introduced in the game at that time.<ref name="soe.lithium">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=jedi&message.id=1286265|text=A perfect way to (re)introduce all named color crystals and flawless pearls: Chu-Gon Dar Cube!|archiveurl=https://www.swgemu.com/archive/scrapbookv51/data/20070213155714/index.html|nolive=1}}</ref><ref name="thehonorempire">{{WebCite|url=https://www.thehonorempire.org/web/forums/topic/8045-rare-color-crystal-colors|text=Rare Color Crystal Colors|archivedate=20250801192732}}</ref> Bondara's Folly was eventually added to the game with the release of the [[w:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]] on [[November 1]], [[2007]],<ref name="C7">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref> as one of four possible rewards from a series of in-game collections. This particular series of collections required the player to collect various crystal fragments of different types&mdash;which could be found as loot from a wide variety of enemies in the game&mdash;and combine them with each other. Doing so produced a single shard required for another series of four collections. Once all of the second set of shards were collected, the player could choose as a reward either the crystal or one of four bracelets used for protection against various damage types.<ref name="SWG:RCS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Rare Crystal Shards}}</ref> A few years later, the [[W:c:swg:Hotfix 21.3|Hotfix 21.3]] added "raids" to the game, causing high-level creatures to attack various cities and settlements in the game.<ref name="21.3">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=69224&month=102011|text=Star Wars Galaxies Hotfix 21.3 -- Thursday, October 13, 2011}}</ref> On [[October 20]], [[2011]], the [[W:c:swg:Hotfix 21.4|Hotfix 21.4]] added the possibility of obtaining rare loot items for enemies during these raids,<ref name="21.4">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=69225&month=102011|text=Star Wars Galaxies Hotfix 21.4 -- Thursday, October 20, 2011}}</ref> including Bondara's Folly.<ref name="SWG" />
